Case 03 · Shopify / e-commerce

Fixing crawl waste and rendering on a JavaScript-heavy Shopify store

A large Shopify store rendered much of its content with JavaScript and generated a large inventory of dynamic URLs.

Vertical
E-commerce
Site
Large JavaScript-rendered Shopify store
Window
16 months
Source
Google Search Console

Results

Clicks449KSearch Console · 16 months

Average CTR1.1%clicks ÷ impressions
Average position8.21 = top of page one

Monthly average = 16 months total ÷ 16. Real months vary; this is arithmetic, not a trend line.

The situation

A large Shopify store rendered much of its content with JavaScript and generated a large inventory of dynamic URLs.

Crawl budget was being spent on URLs that did not earn revenue, while collection and product pages needed to be understood clearly by search systems.

What I did

  1. 01

    Business and entity analysis

    Ran a domain-wide business and entity analysis, an initial technical audit, and collection-page keyword research.

  2. 02

    Collection inventory

    Optimized the collection inventory and mapped product attributes.

  3. 03

    Pages from a controlled template

    Generated collection pages in bulk from a controlled template, and built author and brand-authority pages.

  4. 04

    Rendering analysis

    Ran Googlebot rendering and server-side rendering (SSR) analysis.

  5. 05

    Crawl-budget rules

    Fixed a large dynamic URL inventory through crawl-budget rules, canonicalization, redirects, and pruning.

  6. 06

    Structured data and feeds

    Aligned dynamic schema with Google Merchant Center.

Before & After Technical Architecture

BEFORE Client-Side JavaScript Bottlenecks
  • Client-side JavaScript rendering delaying Googlebot indexation
  • Crawl budget exhausted on non-revenue parameter & tag URLs
  • Unstructured product attribute schemas causing Merchant Center disconnects
AFTER SSR & Collection Controls
  • Server-Side Rendering (SSR) checks & pre-rendered collection templates
  • Strict canonicalization, robots.txt disallows, & dynamic URL pruning
  • Dynamic schema integration matching Google Merchant Center feeds
